title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 4150 Chicago Avenue in Riverside, California, as the Woodie Rucker-Hughes Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 4150 Chicago Avenue in Riverside, California, as the "Woodie Rucker-Hughes Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Congress named a post office in Riverside, California, after Woodie Rucker-Hughes.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 4150 Chicago Avenue in Riverside, California, as the Woodie Rucker-Hughes Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on January 5, 2021.
